proved_chain: With an explicit representative section and identity output map, fibre-consistent Step/Learn guards, outputs and quotient successors are necessary and sufficient for an exact abstract dynamics; all finite mixed traces are preserved.
An explicit source-reconstructing output-exact encoding factors uniquely through reachable codes onto the behavioral quotient. Equal output behavior alone does not preserve Learn guards.

An explicitly polymorphic typed finite n-ary codec is invertible. Constructed stored dynamics preserve all finite Step/Learn traces; the existing computed semantic revision witness changes the next stored execution.

selected_branch_cases: Actual admitted candidate revision 1 is read by fresh next semantic execution.
Fallback fresh execution reads unchanged baseline revision 0.
Switched arm/altered state digest/role label are rejected before next operation.
Changed evaluation row identity with the same aggregate and wrong training trace digest are rejected.
A second actual admitted revision after selection invalidates the recorded choice before next operation.

assumptions: Abstract Dynamics are declared deterministic functions with explicit Step/Learn permissions. Quotient construction has a given section; output map is identity.
Behavioral minimality concerns all finite output traces and explicit encode/decode pairs reconstructing a behaviorally equivalent source state, not arbitrary physical storage.
Storage equivalence fixes finite factor count, arities and typed addresses within the contract. The reference operator is not a real pretrained LLM.
Runtime selection uses caller-declared Boolean predictions, weighted rows, corruption allowance and cost with exact bigint arithmetic. Training digests bind stored records, not independent truth.
Branch services and a fresh opener are caller-provided. Both roots must remain quiescent through reopening and next execution; there is no cross-process transaction.

historical_scope_correction.finding: Historical encodeNary/decodeNary implicitly resolve Role/Vertex to fixed namespace enums despite a generic description.
historical_scope_correction.resolution: New HSWM.ExecutableGraphEncoding.encode/decode explicitly bind Payload/Tag/Endpoint. Historical fixed-domain results and bytes remain unchanged.

limitations: No universal minimum-cost hypergraph theorem; opposite cost witnesses remain valid and binary incidence can preserve n-ary information.
Output-only behavioral quotient does not preserve permission, provenance or lineage without making them observable and proving the stronger contract.
No proof that arbitrary local read scope is sufficient for physical reality, a pretrained LLM or CHU.
No TypeScript/Lean compiler refinement, calibrated real-valued confidence-bound implementation or authenticated model evaluation.
Selected-branch API is an opt-in library path, not global branch promotion, a canonical Permit, or default lifecycle CLI behavior.
No real-model efficacy result, open topology discovery, equal-cost superiority or same-configuration CR-0..7/FCL-1..8 closure.
